```kotlin
    SettingsRow(label = "Active Instructions", description = "3 Active", onClick = {})
    SettingsRow(label = "Muted Contacts", onClick = {}, trailing = {
        EqualText(text = "4", style = EqualTheme.type.body1, color = EqualTheme.colors.textSecondary)
    })
    SettingsRow(label = "Version", description = "2.4.0", trailing = null) // null = no chevron
}
```

### Group: Monetization

#### Cancellation (`cancel-sheet`)

Three steps to cancel: tell us why (Proceed stays disabled until there is text), confirm, and the request submitted with access kept until the end date.

- React: `import { CancelSheet } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `CancelSheet`
- Tokens: `gradient/status-neutral`, `button/primary`, `stroke/subtle`
- Source: Monetization Flow · cancellation

Props of `CancelSheet`:
- `step`: `'feedback' | 'confirm' | 'submitted'`. Step.
- `accessUntil?`: `string` = '15 June 2026'. Access end date.
- `reason / onReasonChange?`: `string / (v) => void`. Feedback text (controlled or not).
- `onProceed / onKeep / onConfirm / onRedirect?`: `() => void`. Step actions.

Do: Say how long access lasts at every step.

Don't: Don't make Proceed tappable before the user writes a reason.

Anatomy:
1. Scrim: Dimmed layer behind the sheet. A tap calls onClose (web) or onDismiss (Android) when one is passed; otherwise it only swallows taps. (bg/overlay #1E1E1E @ 40% · full-size layer)
2. Sheet panel: Bottom panel that holds the status card and footer (StatusSheet). (bg/surface · radius 24 top (24 all round inline) · padding 12/12/20 · shadow 0 -8 30 black/12%)
3. Close button: Feedback step only, web: floating X at the top-right that calls onClose. (IconButton ghost 40 · close 24 text/primary · inset 8/8 · 48 touch area)
4. Status card: Neutral ring card with the 3D art: sad face for feedback and confirm, thumbs up when submitted. (gradient/status-neutral · radius 20 · 1dp stroke/subtle · padding 18/16 · rings white 60% · art 100dp (Asset, decorative))
5. Title lines: Two display lines, light line first: 'We're Sad to / See you Cancel', 'Are you really / Sure?', 'Your Request is / Submitted'. One heading. (light 22/26 Regular (title) · strong 28/32 Bold -0.02em (headline) · text/primary · centred · 10 below the art · rises in over motion.paymentStatus)
6. Body: Says when access ends and what happens to autopay. (body1 · text/secondary · centred · 8 above)
7. Reason field (feedback): Three-line text area for the reason for cancelling. (radius 12 · 1dp stroke/subtle, action/stroke/unread when focused · bg/surface · padding 12/14 · body1 text/primary · placeholder text/placeholder (Android) · 16 above)
8. Footer: Proceed (disabled until there is text); or Cancel (outline) + Confirm; or the 3s RedirectNote. (Button lg block 45 · gap 12 · RedirectNote body2 text/action · footer padding 16 top, 8 sides)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: The panel is role="dialog" (aria-modal in overlay mode). The two title lines sit in one element with role="heading" aria-level 2. The art is decorative (alt=""). Android: The panel sets paneTitle. The two title lines are merged into one heading(). The art has no contentDescription.
- Name. Web: aria-label per step: 'Cancel subscription', 'Confirm cancellation', 'Request submitted'. The textarea is labelled 'Why are you cancelling?'. The close button is 'Close'. Android: paneTitle uses the same three labels. The reason field has contentDescription 'Why are you cancelling?'.
- Keyboard. Web: useModal moves focus into the sheet, traps Tab, makes the screen behind inert, closes on Escape (onClose, onKeep on confirm, onRedirect on submitted) and returns focus on close. Android: With onDismiss, system Back and a scrim tap close the sheet (EqualBackHandler). TalkBack: swipe through card, field and buttons, double-tap to activate.
- Touch target. Web: lg buttons are 45px tall with eq-touch, so the hit area is 48. The close IconButton is 40 with eq-touch (48). Android: EqualButton applies minimumInteractiveComponentSize, so the 45dp buttons get a 48dp target.
- Contrast. Web: Body text/secondary is 5.3:1 at the #E1E1E1 top of the neutral gradient and 5.7:1 on white; titles 10.5:1 or more. White on green (Proceed/Confirm), the green outline Cancel label and the green RedirectNote are 2.85:1 in light (accepted brand decision). Dark: body 4.8:1 at #434343, black on lime 17.4:1. Android: Same tokens and ratios. The light-mode primary and outline buttons and RedirectNote are 2.85:1 (brand green); dark passes.
- State. Web: Proceed uses the native disabled attribute until there is text, so it leaves the tab order and nothing says why. The redirect notice is spoken once through a polite Announce region; the visible ticking text is aria-hidden. Android: Proceed is enabled = false, which TalkBack reads as 'disabled'. RedirectNote announces 'Redirecting to home in 3 seconds' once (polite liveRegion), not every tick.
- Motion. Web: The panel rises with eq-sheet-up (320ms) and the title lines step in; both are switched off under prefers-reduced-motion. Android: The panel slides up 40% and fades in over motion.slow, and the title rises in; both are skipped when rememberReduceMotion() is true.

Known accessibility gaps:
- CancelSheet in Monetization.tsx: Proceed uses native disabled, so keyboard users can't reach it and nothing explains that a reason is required. Use aria-disabled plus a hint.
- CancelSheet in Monetization.kt: the feedback step has no visible close button (web has one), and when onDismiss is not passed the sheet has no way out at all.
- RedirectNote (Monetization.tsx / Monetization.kt) leaves the screen after 3s with no way to pause or extend the time.
- The reason field's only edge is a 1dp stroke/subtle border (black 5%, about 1.1:1 on white), below the 3:1 a text-input boundary needs (Monetization.css .eq-cancel-reason / CancelReasonField in Monetization.kt).
- Accepted brand decision: the outline Cancel label and the RedirectNote text are text/action #00B140 on white, 2.85:1 in light mode (Button.css / Monetization.tsx, Buttons.kt / Monetization.kt).
- Accepted brand decision: primary buttons put text/on-action white on button/primary #00B140 in light mode, 2.85:1 for 14sp text (Button.css / Buttons.kt). Dark (black on lime) is 17.4:1.

Example: Feedback
```tsx
<CancelSheet step="feedback" reason={reason} onReasonChange={setReason} onProceed={next} />
```
```kotlin
var reason by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
CancelSheet(step = CancelStep.Feedback, reason = reason, onReasonChange = { reason = it },
    onProceed = { /* next step */ }, inline = true)
```

Example: Feedback filled
```tsx
<CancelSheet step="feedback" reason="Felt it too expensive…" onReasonChange={setReason} onProceed={next} />
```
```kotlin
var reason by remember { mutableStateOf("Felt it too expensive, I hope it would be under my budget") }
CancelSheet(step = CancelStep.Feedback, reason = reason, onReasonChange = { reason = it },
    onProceed = { /* next step */ }, inline = true)
```

Example: Are you really sure?
```tsx
<CancelSheet step="confirm" accessUntil="15 June 2026" onKeep={close} onConfirm={cancel} />
```
```kotlin
CancelSheet(step = CancelStep.Confirm, accessUntil = "15 June 2026", onKeep = { /* close */ },
    onConfirm = { /* cancel subscription */ }, inline = true)
```

Example: Request submitted
```tsx
<CancelSheet step="submitted" accessUntil="15 June 2026" onRedirect={goHome} />
```
```kotlin
CancelSheet(step = CancelStep.Submitted, accessUntil = "15 June 2026", onRedirect = { /* go home */ }, inline = true)
```

#### Coupon ticket (`coupon-ticket`)

A notched ticket with the coupon code, what it saves, APPLY / APPLIED and the big discount line.

- React: `import { CouponTicket } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `CouponTicket`
- Tokens: `bg/surface`, `gradient/coupon-stroke`, `paywall/divider`, `text/gold`, `gradient/gold-text`
- Source: Monetization Flow · EQUAL25

Props of `CouponTicket`:
- `code`: `string`. Coupon code.
- `description`: `ReactNode`. What it saves.
- `discount`: `string`. Big gold line, e.g. "25% OFF".
- `applied?`: `boolean`. Shows APPLIED; the price above drops.
- `onApply?`: `() => void`. APPLY tap.

Do: Drop the price in PriceTag when the coupon applies (₹249 → ₹149).

Don't: Don't show more than one coupon at a time.

Anatomy:
1. Ticket: Notched card. (radius xl (20) · two 9 notches at 58% height (web mask / Compose TicketShape) · bg/surface · 1 px gradient/coupon-stroke · padding 14 16 12)
2. Code: The coupon code. (Text subheading Bold · text/gold · one line on Compose)
3. Description: What it saves. (Text caption Regular · text/secondary)
4. APPLY / APPLIED: Apply action, then its applied state. (gap 12 from the text · Text buttonSmall Bold · text/gold · padding-top 4 · 48 touch area)
5. Dashed rule and seal: Divider with the 3D % seal. (6 above, 2 below · 1 px dashed paywall/divider · Asset coupon-seal 28 · gap 10)
6. Discount: Big discount line. (30/36 Bold · gradient/gold-text · centred)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: APPLY is a <button>; APPLIED is a focusable span; a persistent polite Announce region speaks the change; the seal is alt="". Android: APPLY is a clickable(role = Role.Button) text; a persistent Box with liveRegion = Polite wraps APPLY / APPLIED; the seal has no contentDescription.
- Name. Web: The button reads "Apply EQUAL25"; APPLIED reads "EQUAL25 applied"; the region announces "Coupon EQUAL25 applied". Android: APPLY reads "Apply EQUAL25"; APPLIED reads "EQUAL25 applied".
- Keyboard. Web: Tab to APPLY; Enter / Space. When APPLIED replaces it, focus moves to the APPLIED text (useFocusHandoff). Android: TalkBack: swipe to APPLY, double-tap; the live region announces the applied state.
- Touch target. Web: APPLY uses eq-touch for a 48 px hit area. Android: APPLY uses minimumInteractiveComponentSize (48 dp).
- Contrast. Web: Code and APPLY text/gold #9E6A28 on white 4.6:1; description text/secondary 5.7:1. The discount gradient is about 3:1 mid-glyph and 1.8:1 at its #FFB251 highlight. Dark: gold #E8BD62 9.3:1. Android: Same tokens, same ratios.
- State. Web: Applied swaps APPLY for the word APPLIED (not colour alone) and is announced once by the persistent live region. Android: Applied swaps the text; the persistent polite live region announces it.
- Motion. Web: Static; the price drop above it animates in PriceTag (off under reduced motion). Android: Static.

Known accessibility gaps:
- Accepted brand decision (premium gold, subscription surfaces only): the gradient/gold-text discount line runs from #FFB251 (1.8:1 on white) to #603600, so the top of the 30 px text falls under 3:1 even as large text (Monetization.css .eq-gold-text, Monetization.kt GoldText).

Example: Available
```tsx
<CouponTicket code="EQUAL25" description="Save Flat ₹100 with this Code" discount="25% OFF" onApply={apply} />
```
```kotlin
CouponTicket(code = "EQUAL25", description = "Save Flat ₹100 with this Code", discount = "25% OFF", onApply = {})
```

Example: Applied
```tsx
<CouponTicket code="EQUAL25" description="Save Flat ₹100 with this Code" discount="25% OFF" applied />
```
```kotlin
CouponTicket(code = "EQUAL25", description = "Save Flat ₹100 with this Code", discount = "25% OFF", applied = true)
```

#### Discount badge & price drop (`discount-badge`)

The green 25% OFF seal with its label, and the price drop it rides on: APPLY strikes the old price, the new price lands beside the list price with Saved ₹100, then the badge pops.

- React: `import { DiscountBadge, PriceTag } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `DiscountBadge`, `PriceTag`
- Tokens: `text/action`, `gradient/gold-text`
- Source: Monetization local components

Props of `DiscountBadge`:
- `label?`: `string` = 'Discounted!!'. Green label.
- `off?`: `string` = '25%'. Seal text.
- `animate?`: `boolean`. Pop in.

Props of `PriceTag`:
- `price`: `number`. Price now.
- `was?`: `number`. Struck list price; adds /Monthly and Saved ₹.
- `badge?`: `string`. A DiscountBadge under the price.
- `animate?`: `boolean`. Run the strike → land → pop sequence (still under reduced motion).

Do: Animate only when the user caused the change (APPLY).

Don't: Don't animate a price that was already discounted when the page opened.

Anatomy:
1. DiscountBadge pill: White pill that holds the seal and its label. (radius full · bg/surface · padding 2/10/2/2 · gap 6 · shadow 0 2 10 black 8%)
2. OffSeal: Coded green wavy seal with the discount. (28 · 12 lobes · text/action fill · '25%' over 'OFF' Bold text/on-action · decorative)
3. Label: What the discount is. (caption Bold · text/action · 'Discounted!!' or 'Special Coupon Applied!')
4. PriceTag: label: Promotion line over the price. (caption uppercase · text/gold · 🎊 Emoji either side (decorative; 12 EmojiGlyph in Compose, gap 4))
5. PriceTag: price: Big gold price between hairlines. (44/48 Bold -0.02em · gradient/gold-text · paywall/divider fading rules · gap 16)
6. PriceTag: was + period: Struck list price and the period beside the price. (14 Medium tabular, struck · '/Monthly' 14 · text/secondary · gap 6 on the baseline)
7. PriceTag: saved line: How much the user saves. ('Saved ₹100' · caption Bold · text/action)
8. Strike line: Gold bar that strikes the old price during the drop. (3 · text/gold · 108% wide · 52% down · radius 2 · animation only)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: DiscountBadge is role=status (polite live region); OffSeal is an aria-hidden svg; PriceTag is plain text. Android: DiscountBadge uses clearAndSetSemantics with liveRegion Polite; the struck price has its own contentDescription.
- Name. Web: The badge reads '25% off. Discounted!!' through a visually hidden prefix. The price reads '₹149, was ₹249 /Monthly'. Android: Badge reads '25% off. Discounted!!'; the struck price reads 'was ₹249 /Monthly'.
- Keyboard. Web: Not interactive: the badge and price are read in order; the APPLY that triggers the drop lives on the coupon. Android: Not interactive; TalkBack reads the label, price and badge in order.
- Touch target. Web: Not interactive, so no target. Android: Not interactive, so no target.
- Contrast. Web: Accepted brand decision: label and Saved line (text/action) and the seal's white text are 2.85:1 in light; dark is lime with black text, 17:1. The gold-text price runs from 1.8:1 (#FFB251) to 10.4:1 on white; text/gold label is 4.6:1 on white, 4.0:1 on the paywall hero's top colour. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: The discount is in text (seal, label, struck price, Saved ₹), not colour. During the drop only the badge, as a live region, announces the change. Android: Same; the badge's live region announces when it appears.
- Motion. Web: Strike draws from 300ms over 450ms, the new price lands at 800ms (motion.priceDrop) and the badge pops with a spring after 120ms while the seal spins in. Under prefers-reduced-motion the old → strike phases are skipped and the final state shows at once. Android: Same sequence; under rememberReduceMotion the final state shows at once.

Known accessibility gaps:
- Accepted brand decision: the text/action label and Saved line, and the seal's white text on text/action, are 2.85:1 in light theme (Monetization.tsx and Monetization.kt).
- Accepted brand decision (premium gold, subscription surfaces only): priceTag price (gradient/gold-text, .eq-gold-text in Monetization.css and GoldText in Monetization.kt) starts at #FFB251, 1.8:1 on white, so the light part of the 44 px glyphs is below 3:1 for large text.

Example: Badges
```tsx
<DiscountBadge />
<DiscountBadge label="Special Coupon Applied!" />
```
```kotlin
Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    DiscountBadge()
    DiscountBadge(label = "Special Coupon Applied!")
}
```

Example: Price drop
```tsx
<PriceTag price={149} was={249} badge="Special Coupon Applied!" animate={justApplied} />
```
```kotlin
var replay by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    // Strike the old price → land the new one with "Saved ₹100" → pop the badge
    key(replay) {
        PriceTag(price = "149", was = 249, badge = "Special Coupon Applied!", animate = true)
    }
    EqualButton(text = "Replay", onClick = { replay++ }, variant = EqualButtonVariant.Secondary, size = EqualButtonSize.Xs)
}
```

#### FAQ (`faq`)

The FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS accordion on the paywall and the subscription page, and the hairline section label it sits under.

- React: `import { FaqList, DividerLabel } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `FaqList`, `DividerLabel`
- Tokens: `bg/surface`, `stroke/subtle`, `paywall/divider`, `text/secondary`
- Source: Monetization Flow · FAQ

Props of `FaqList`:
- `items`: `{ q: string; a: ReactNode }[]`. Questions.
- `title?`: `string | null` = 'Frequently asked questions'. Label above.
- `defaultOpen?`: `number[]` = []. Expanded rows.

Do: Answer cancellation and refunds plainly.

Don't: Don't put the FAQ above the CTA.

Anatomy:
1. DividerLabel: Section heading between two gold hairlines. (1dp paywall/divider rules · gap 12 · caption uppercase +0.02em · text/primary (gold tone text/gold) · h2 on web, heading() in Compose)
2. Card: One card that holds every question. (radius 16 · bg/surface · 1dp stroke/subtle · 14 below the label)
3. Question row: FaqEntry button that opens and closes the answer. (padding 14 vertical / 16 horizontal · bodyLarge text/primary · gap 12)
4. Chevron: Shows whether the row is open. (chevron-down 20 · text/secondary · rotated 180 when open · decorative)
5. Answer: The answer, shown only while open. (body1 · text/secondary · padding 0 16 14)
6. Row divider: Hairline between questions. (1dp stroke/subtle)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: Each question is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its answer, inside a section; DividerLabel renders as an h2. Android: Question row is clickable(Role.Button) with stateDescription; DividerLabel is a heading().
- Name. Web: The question text; the chevron icon is aria-hidden. Android: The question text; the chevron has contentDescription null.
- Keyboard. Web: Tab to each question, Enter/Space toggles; the answer follows the button in reading order. Android: TalkBack reads 'question, Collapsed, Button'; double-tap toggles.
- Touch target. Web: Full-width rows about 52 px tall. Android: Full-width rows about 52dp tall.
- Contrast. Web: Question text/primary 12.6:1; answer and chevron text/secondary 5.7:1 on white, 6.7:1 on #1F1F1F in dark. Gold label tone text/gold is 4.6:1 on white. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: Open state is aria-expanded plus the visible answer and chevron rotation, not colour. Android: stateDescription 'Expanded' / 'Collapsed' plus the visible answer; open rows survive configuration changes.
- Motion. Web: No animation; the chevron flips and the answer appears instantly. Android: No animation.

Example: Accordion
```tsx
<FaqList items={faq} defaultOpen={[3]} />
```
```kotlin
val faq = listOf(
    FaqItem("What do I get with Equal Unlimited?", "Unlimited call screenings, full recordings, summaries, and zero daily cap."),
    FaqItem("Will Equal screen all types of calls?", "Yes! Delivery, ride pickups, spam, loan calls, Equal handles them all."),
    FaqItem("Can I cancel my Equal Unlimited plan later?", "Yes, cancel anytime. Your Unlimited access stays active until the end of your billing period."),
    FaqItem("Will I get a refund if I’m not happy with Equal Unlimited?", "We don’t offer refunds, but you can write to our support team and we’ll do our best to help."),
)
FaqList(items = faq, defaultOpen = listOf(3))
```

Example: Section label
```tsx
<DividerLabel>Why people choose</DividerLabel>
```
```kotlin
DividerLabel(text = "Why people choose")
```

#### Feature list (`feature-list`)

What You Get on the plan page: one card per Unlimited feature with its 3D gold icon (24/7 Unlimited Call Screening, Unlimited Recordings, Unlimited Summaries).

- React: `import { FeatureList, unlimitedFeatures } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `FeatureList`
- Tokens: `stroke/subtle`, `bg/surface`
- Source: Monetization value · Manage Plan

Props of `FeatureList`:
- `items?`: `{ art: AssetName; label: string }[]` = unlimitedFeatures. Features, top to bottom; art is a 3D feature-* asset.

Do: Keep labels to one line. Use the 3D feature-* art; add a new asset for a new feature.

Don't: Don't swap in flat Material icons here. Don't list more than five; the page already has FAQ and proof.

Anatomy:
1. List: The stack of Unlimited features under What You Get. (web ul · Compose Column with collectionInfo · gap 10)
2. Card: One card per feature. (radius 12 · bg/surface · 1dp stroke/subtle · padding 14/16 · gap 12)
3. Art: 3D gold feature icon. (28 feature-* Asset (feature-call-screening, feature-recordings, feature-summaries) · decorative)
4. Label: The feature, on one line. (subheading Regular · text/primary)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: A ul of li items, so screen readers announce a list of N items. Android: The Column sets collectionInfo and each card collectionItemInfo, so TalkBack announces a list of N items.
- Name. Web: The label text; art has alt ''. Android: The label text (each card merges into one stop); art has contentDescription null.
- Keyboard. Web: Not interactive; no Tab stops. Android: Not interactive; TalkBack reads each label in order.
- Touch target. Web: Not interactive, so no target. Android: Not interactive, so no target.
- Contrast. Web: text/primary on bg/surface: 12.6:1 light, 10.9:1 dark; the card border is decorative. Android: Same tokens as web.
- State. Web: No states; every feature is always listed. Android: No states.
- Motion. Web: No animation. Android: No animation.

Example: What You Get
```tsx
<DividerLabel>What You Get</DividerLabel>
<FeatureList items={unlimitedFeatures} />
```
```kotlin
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
    DividerLabel(text = "What You Get")
    FeatureList(items = UnlimitedFeatures)
}
```

#### Help Center sheet (`help-center-sheet`)

Opened from Support on the paywall (or Contact Support after a pending payment): call or mail the team.

- React: `import { HelpCenterSheet } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `HelpCenterSheet`
- Tokens: `bg/surface`, `stroke/subtle`, `action-card/highlight`, `text/action`
- Source: Monetization Flow · Help Center

Props of `HelpCenterSheet`:
- `phone / email?`: `string` = +91 9876 543210 / hello@equal.in. Contact rows.
- `onCall / onMail?`: `() => void`. Row taps.

Do: Keep it to the two contact routes.

Don't: Don't send people to a web page from here.

Anatomy:
1. Sheet panel: StatusSheet panel over the scrim, labelled Help Center, with a close button on web. (bg/surface · radius 24 top · padding 12/12/20 · content inset 8/8/0 · web: IconButton close 40 (48 touch) 8 from the top-right)
2. SheetHeading: title: The sheet's title. (title Medium · text/primary · h2 on web, heading() in Compose)
3. SheetHeading: body: One line saying how the team can help. (body1 · text/secondary · 4 above)
4. HelpContactRow: A tappable route to support: Call Us or Mail Us. (radius 14 · 1dp stroke/subtle · padding 12/12/12/16 · gap 12 · 16 above the first, 12 between)
5. HelpContactRow: text: What the route is and the number or address. (title subheading text/primary over value body1 text/secondary)
6. HelpContactRow: icon tile: Green pill with the call or mail icon. (52 × 36 · radius full · action-card/highlight · 22 icon text/action · decorative)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: Panel is role=dialog (aria-modal in overlay) with an h2; Close and each HelpContactRow are native buttons. Android: Panel has paneTitle 'Help Center'; SheetHeading title has heading(); rows are clickable(Role.Button).
- Name. Web: Each row is named by its text, e.g. 'Call Us +91 9876 543210'; the icon is aria-hidden; the X is 'Close'. Android: Row text merges into 'Call Us, +91 9876 543210'; the icon has contentDescription null; the scrim's action is 'Dismiss'.
- Keyboard. Web: useModal moves focus in, traps Tab and closes on Escape; the X and the scrim also close it. Android: TalkBack: jump to the 'Help Center' heading, swipe to the rows, double-tap. System Back and a scrim tap call onClose.
- Touch target. Web: Rows are full width and about 66 px tall; the close button has a 48 px hit area. Android: Rows are full width and about 66dp tall.
- Contrast. Web: Title text/primary (12.6:1) and value text/secondary (5.7:1) pass. Accepted brand decision: the icon text/action on action-card/highlight is 2.6:1 in light (below 3:1); lime on #2F3423 is 10.7:1 in dark. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: No selected or disabled state; press shows a 0.97 scale (eq-pressable). Android: No state; press shows the ripple.
- Motion. Web: Sheet slides up (motion.slow); off under prefers-reduced-motion. Android: StatusSheet slides up and fades in; static under rememberReduceMotion().

Known accessibility gaps:
- Accepted brand decision: HelpContactRow icon (text/action on action-card/highlight) is 2.6:1 in light theme, below 3:1 for icons (Monetization.tsx and Monetization.kt).
- HelpCenterSheet in Monetization.kt has no visible close button (web has an X); it closes only on Back or a scrim tap, and only when onClose is passed.

Example: Default
```tsx
<HelpCenterSheet phone="+91 9876 543210" email="hello@equal.in" onCall={call} onMail={mail} />
```
```kotlin
HelpCenterSheet(phone = "+91 9876 543210", email = "hello@equal.in", onCall = {}, onMail = {}, inline = true)
```

#### Locked content (`locked-content`)

How free users see what Unlimited unlocks: blurred previews with the crown-lock badge, the Unlock All Details card, and the Unlock Audio pill. Each is a paywall touchpoint.

- React: `import { Locked, LockBadge, UnlockDetailsCard, UnlockAudioPill, ChatListItem, ChatBubble, CallSummary } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `LockedContent`, `LockBadge`, `UnlockDetailsCard`, `UnlockAudioPill`
- Tokens: `locked/badge-bg`, `locked/badge-stroke`, `gradient/status-gold`, `button/primary`
- Source: Monetization Flow · touchpoints

Props of `Locked`:
- `children`: `ReactNode`. Real content, blurred.
- `badge?`: `boolean` = true. Crown-lock badge.
- `inline?`: `boolean`. One line (chat-list previews).

Props of `UnlockDetailsCard`:
- `title / body / cta?`: `string` = Unlock All Details…. Copy.
- `onUnlock?`: `() => void`. Opens the paywall.

Props of `ChatListItem · ChatBubble · CallSummary`:
- `locked?`: `boolean · boolean · 'audio' | 'all'`. Locked state on the existing components.
- `onUnlock?`: `() => void`. CallSummary: Unlock Audio tap.

Do: Blur the real content so the user sees there is something there. Route every locked tap to the paywall with its touchpoint.

Don't: Don't lock the caller's name or the time; only the content. Don't show the crown-lock to paid users.

Anatomy:
1. Locked wrapper: Wraps the real content in place so the layout stays the same while it is hidden. (web span.eq-locked inline-flex · gap 6 (inline: full-width flex) · Compose LockedContent Box (Row when inline, full width, gap 6))
2. Blurred content: The real preview, blurred so the user can tell something is there. (blur 4px / Modifier.blur(4.dp) · pointer-events none, user-select none on web · Compose blur needs API 31+)
3. LockBadge: Gold crown with a padlock that marks the item as locked. (crown-lock Asset · 18 (16 inline) · locked/badge-bg circle, 1dp locked/badge-stroke, 2dp padding, 6 right / 8 below the corner · inline: no disc)
4. UnlockDetailsCard: header: Paywall card docked over a locked conversation: crown, title and one line. (radius 20 · gradient/status-gold · white rings · shadow 0 -10 30 black 8% · padding 16/16/18 · AnimatedCrown 56 · title 22/26 Bold text/primary · body body1 text/secondary)
5. UnlockDetailsCard: CTA: Gold button with the lock icon that opens the paywall. (Button gold lg (45 high, 48 touch) · leading lock 18 · gradient/cta-gold · white Bold label · 14 above)
6. UnlockAudioPill: Green pill over a locked recording that opens the paywall. (32 high (48 touch) · padding 0 16 · radius full · button/primary · lock 14 + buttonSmall Bold text/on-action · gap 6 · shadow 0 6 16 button/primary 30%)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: Locked is a span: the content is aria-hidden and a visually hidden sentence replaces it; the badge inside it is decorative (alt ''). UnlockDetailsCard CTA and UnlockAudioPill are native buttons. Android: LockedContent uses clearAndSetSemantics with one contentDescription; UnlockAudioPill is clickable(Role.Button); the CTA is EqualButton.
- Name. Web: Locked reads 'Locked. Unlock Equal Unlimited to see this.' once. Buttons use their visible labels, Unlock Details and Unlock Audio. Android: LockedContent reads 'Locked. Unlock Equal Unlimited to see this.' (the badge is cleared inside it). Buttons use their visible labels.
- Keyboard. Web: Locked itself is not focusable; the parent row or bubble, or the Unlock buttons, take Tab and Enter/Space. Android: TalkBack: swipe to the locked block, which reads as one item; double-tap Unlock Details or Unlock Audio to open the paywall.
- Touch target. Web: UnlockAudioPill (32 px) and the lg CTA (45 px) both carry eq-touch, so each hit area is at least 48 px. Android: UnlockAudioPill uses minimumInteractiveComponentSize (48dp); EqualButton also enforces 48dp.
- Contrast. Web: Accepted brand decision: the pill's white on button/primary #00B140 is 2.85:1 in light; dark is black on lime #BAFF29, 17:1. Card title text/primary is 12.6:1 and body text/secondary 5.5:1 on the gold tint; the gold CTA's white label runs 4.2:1 down to 2.3:1 across gradient/cta-gold. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: Locked is shown by blur plus the crown badge and spoken as text, so it never relies on blur alone. Android: Locked is spoken as text and marked by the badge. Below API 31 the blur is a no-op, so the content is drawn readable.
- Motion. Web: AnimatedCrown sways (4.8s loop) and the gold CTA has a sheen and glow; all stop under prefers-reduced-motion. Android: AnimatedCrown and the gold CTA sheen/glow are static when rememberReduceMotion() is true.

Known accessibility gaps:
- Accepted brand decision: UnlockAudioPill (Monetization.tsx/.css and Monetization.kt) puts white text on button/primary #00B140, 2.85:1 in light theme.
- Accepted brand decision (premium gold, subscription surfaces only): the gold CTA on UnlockDetailsCard (Button gold, Button.css and Buttons.kt) puts a white label on gradient/cta-gold, 4.2:1 at #A37236 falling to 2.3:1 at #C8A774; the label needs 4.5:1 throughout.
- LockedContent in Monetization.kt: Modifier.blur is a no-op below API 31, so locked content is drawn readable on older Android (documented as an accepted degradation).

Example: Locked chat rows
```tsx
<ChatListItem name="Vijay CA" preview="Your KYC is pending" date="1 May"
  avatar={{ category: 'financial' }} locked onClick={openPaywall} />
```
```kotlin
Column {
    ChatListItem(name = "Amit Nanda", preview = "Amit is done with onboarding.", date = "Yesterday",
        category = EqualCategory.Career)
    ChatListItem(name = "Vijay CA", preview = "Your KYC is pending", date = "1 May",
        category = EqualCategory.Financial, locked = true, onClick = { /* open paywall */ })
    ChatListItem(name = "Vijay OLA", preview = "On the gate, need approval.", date = "1 Jul",
        category = EqualCategory.Ride, locked = true, onClick = { /* open paywall */ })
}
```

Example: Locked bubbles and audio
```tsx
<ChatBubble kind="incoming" locked>…</ChatBubble>
<CallSummary summary="…" locked="audio" onUnlock={openPaywall} />
```
```kotlin

        message = "We have a 2BHK in Sector 12 with good offer", locked = true)

                total = "2:37", speed = PlaybackSpeed.X1, onSpeedChange = {})
        },
    )
}
```

Example: Unlock All Details

```tsx
<UnlockDetailsCard onUnlock={openPaywall} />
```


Example: Badge and wrapper
```tsx

<Locked><Text variant="body1">…</Text></Locked>
<UnlockAudioPill onClick={openPaywall} />
```
```kotlin

    LockBadge()

        EqualText(text = "Hey this is vijay calling from magicbrick", style = EqualTheme.type.body1,
            color = EqualTheme.colors.textPrimary)
    }

}
```

#### Payment status (`payment-status`)

The result sheets after the user pays: Waiting for Confirmation, Payment Confirmed, Pending, Failed and Congratulations. All share the ring StatusCard.

- React: `import { PaymentStatusSheet, StatusCard, StatusSheet, RedirectNote } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `PaymentStatusSheet`, `StatusCard`, `StatusSheet`, `RedirectNote`
- Tokens: `gradient/status-neutral`, `gradient/status-success`, `gradient/status-warning`, `gradient/status-danger`, `gradient/status-gold`, `bg/overlay`
- Source: Monetization Flow · payment results

Props of `PaymentStatusSheet`:
- `status`: `'waiting' | 'confirmed' | 'pending' | 'failed' | 'welcome'`. Result.
- `cardLast4?`: `string` = '2652'. In the refund line.
- `onRetry / onContactSupport / onRedirect?`: `() => void`. Actions.
- `waitingArt?`: `'status-waiting' | 'status-waiting-cash'` = 'status-waiting'. Experiment: coin or cash art.
- `mode?`: `'overlay' | 'inline'` = 'overlay'. Inline for docs.

Props of `StatusCard`:
- `tone`: `'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'gold'`. Tint.
- `art`: `AssetName`. 3D art (100dp).
- `strong`: `string`. Bold line 28/32.
- `light?`: `string`. Regular line 22/26.
- `strongFirst?`: `boolean` = true. Order of the lines.

Do: Say what happens to the money on pending and failed. Auto-redirect after success, with the countdown visible.

Don't: Don't add a close button; each result has one next step.

Anatomy:
1. Sheet panel: StatusSheet: the panel over a dimmed screen that holds the result; no close button unless the host passes one. (bg/overlay scrim · bg/surface · radius 24 top (24 all round inline) · padding 12/12/20 · shadow 0 -8 30 black 12%)
2. StatusCard container: Tinted ring card that carries the result. (radius 20 · 1dp stroke/subtle · gradient/status-neutral|success|warning|danger|gold · padding 18/16 · white rings (20% in dark))
3. Sunburst: Slowly turning ray burst behind the art on success and welcome. (24 rays · sunburst/ray (white 5%) · centred 70 down · radius 280 · one turn per motion.reward (6s, linear) · decorative)
4. Art: 3D result art. (100 · status-waiting / status-waiting-cash, status-confirmed, status-pending, status-failed · AnimatedCrown 100 for welcome · decorative)
5. Title lines: Two display lines that name the result. (strong 28/32 Bold -0.02em · light 22/26 Regular · text/primary · order from strongFirst · 10 below art · one heading)
6. Body: One line on what happens next or to the money. (body1 text/secondary · 8 above · refund line names card **2652)
7. Footer: The single next step. (padding 16 top, 8 sides · RedirectNote body2 text/action, or block lg primary Button Contact Support / Retry Payment)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: StatusSheet panel is role=dialog with aria-modal in overlay mode; the two title lines are one role=heading level 2; art and Sunburst are hidden. Android: Panel sets paneTitle; the title lines merge into one heading(); art and Sunburst carry no semantics.
- Name. Web: The dialog label follows strongFirst, so it reads 'Waiting for Confirmation', 'Payment Confirmed'. Android: paneTitle follows strongFirst too: 'Waiting for Confirmation', 'Payment Confirmed'.
- Keyboard. Web: useModal moves focus into the panel, traps Tab and closes on Escape when the host passes onClose; Enter/Space activate the footer button. Android: TalkBack: swipe through title, body and footer; double-tap Contact Support or Retry Payment. System Back calls onDismiss when it is set.
- Touch target. Web: Footer Button lg is 45 px tall with eq-touch, a 48 px hit area. Android: EqualButton Block enforces a 48dp minimum.
- Contrast. Web: Titles text/primary and body text/secondary (5.2:1 or more) pass on every tint. Accepted brand decision: footer buttons are white on button/primary #00B140 (2.85:1) and RedirectNote text/action is 2.85:1 on bg/surface in light; dark is lime, 13:1 and up. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: The result is said in words and art as well as tint. Waiting steps (Connecting To Razorpay, Verifying Transaction) are announced once each through Announce. RedirectNote's visible ticks are hidden; screen readers hear 'Redirecting … in 5 seconds' once. Android: Waiting steps change the paneTitle and heading with no live region. RedirectNote is one polite live region with a fixed sentence, so the ticks are not re-read.
- Motion. Web: Sheet slides up, each title rises in, Sunburst turns and the crown sways; all stop under prefers-reduced-motion. Android: Title rise, Sunburst, crown and the StatusSheet slide-up all check rememberReduceMotion().

Known accessibility gaps:
- PaymentStatusSheet in Monetization.kt: the waiting progress steps only change paneTitle and the heading, with no live region, so TalkBack may not announce them (web announces each step once).
- Accepted brand decision: Contact Support / Retry Payment (white on button/primary) and RedirectNote (text/action on bg/surface) are 2.85:1 in light theme (Monetization.tsx and Monetization.kt).

Example: Waiting for Confirmation (Compose)
```kotlin
PaymentStatusSheet(status = PaymentStatus.Waiting, inline = true)
```

Example: Payment Confirmed (Compose)
```kotlin
PaymentStatusSheet(status = PaymentStatus.Confirmed, onRedirect = { /* go home */ }, inline = true)
```

Example: Payment Pending (Compose)
```kotlin
PaymentStatusSheet(status = PaymentStatus.Pending, onContactSupport = { /* open HelpCenterSheet */ }, inline = true)
```

Example: Payment Failed (Compose)
```kotlin
PaymentStatusSheet(status = PaymentStatus.Failed, onRetry = { /* retry payment */ }, inline = true)
```

Example: Congratulations (Compose)
```kotlin
PaymentStatusSheet(status = PaymentStatus.Welcome, onRedirect = { /* go home */ }, inline = true)
```

#### Paywall (`paywall`)

The Equal Unlimited paywall: gold hero with the 3D crown, the price, a preview of what is locked (it changes with the touchpoint), and the sticky gold CTA.

- React: `import { PaywallHero, PriceTag, LockedPreviewCard, PaywallFooter, AnimatedCrown } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `PaywallHero`, `PriceTag`, `LockedPreviewCard`, `PaywallFooter`, `AnimatedCrown`
- Tokens: `gradient/paywall-hero`, `gradient/gold-text`, `gradient/cta-gold`, `text/gold`, `paywall/card-bg`, `paywall/card-stroke`, `paywall/divider`
- Source: Monetization Flow · Unlock Equal Unlimited

Props of `PaywallHero`:
- `title?`: `string` = 'Unlock Equal'. Regular first line.
- `titleStrong?`: `string` = 'Unlimited'. Bold display line.
- `subtitle?`: `ReactNode` = Unlock Summaries…. Experiment: copy variant.
- `onBack / onSupport?`: `() => void`. Header actions; Support opens the Help Center sheet.
- `children?`: `ReactNode`. Price, preview, coupon.

Props of `PriceTag`:
- `price`: `number | string`. Shown price (drops when the coupon applies).
- `label?`: `string | null` = 'Limited time discount'. Gold caps label with 🎊.
- `currency?`: `string` = '₹'. Prefix.

Props of `PaywallFooter`:
- `cta?`: `string` = 'Unlock Unlimited'. Gold block button.
- `note?`: `string | null` = 'Cancel Anytime. Automatically renews'. Caption under it.
- `onClick?`: `() => void`. Starts payment.
- `variant?`: `'gold' | 'gold-outline' | 'primary'` = 'gold'. gold-outline for Cancel Subscription on the plan page.
- `disabled?`: `boolean`. While a payment is processing.
- `flat?`: `boolean`. No surface or shadow, inside the sheet paywall.
- `above?`: `ReactNode`. Above the button, e.g. the processing toast.

Do: Pick the preview from the touchpoint the user came from. Keep one gold CTA; it is the only commit on the page.

Don't: Don't use a serif for the display lines; the system is DM Sans only. Don't hide the auto-renew note.

Anatomy:
1. Hero: Gold gradient with soft rings. (gradient/paywall-hero · 1 px white @50% rings every 70 from r 47, centred 120 from the top, fading over 420 (25% in dark) · padding-bottom 8)
2. Top bar: Back and Support. (56 high · padding 0 12 0 4 · Back IconButton ghost 40 (web) / PlainIconButton 48 (Compose) · Support: Icon help-circle 20 + Text body2 text/primary, gap 6)
3. AnimatedCrown: 3D gold crown with a slow sway. (Asset crown-gold 64 · 4.8 s turntable sway ±20° with a 4 float · drop shadow 0 6 10 #8C5817 @25% · static under reduced motion)
4. Titles: "Unlock Equal" over "Unlimited". (12 above · Text title at 22/26 Regular · Text headline at 38/42 Bold −0.03em · text/primary · one heading)
5. Subtitle: What Unlimited unlocks. (8 above · Text body1 · text/secondary · max width 300 · centred · max 2 lines (Compose))
6. PriceTag: Discount label and the big gold price, or the price drop. (gap 6 · Text caption uppercase text/gold between Emoji 🎊 · price 44/48 Bold gradient/gold-text · hairlines paywall/divider, gap 16 · was price 14 text/secondary struck · Saved caption Bold text/action · DiscountBadge)
7. Body: Price, preview and coupon under the titles. (padding 20 16 8 · gap 16)
8. LockedPreviewCard: Cream frame around a preview of what is locked. (radius xl (20) · paywall/card-bg · 1 px paywall/card-stroke · padding 8 · inner radius 14 bg/surface + 1 px paywall/card-stroke)
9. PaywallFooter: Sticky gold CTA and the renew note. (bg/surface · shadow 0 -6 18 @5% · padding 12 16 16 (flat 14 16 18) · Button lg block 45 gradient/cta-gold, white Bold label · note 8 above, Text caption Regular text/secondary)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: The hero is a <section>; the titles are one <h1> (the visible first line is aria-hidden and repeated inside the h1 as hidden text); Back, Support and the CTA are <button>s; the crown is alt="". PaywallScreen renders the preview inert and aria-hidden with a one-line summary. Android: Back is PlainIconButton, Support a Role.Button row, the CTA an EqualButton; the two title lines are one clearAndSetSemantics node with heading(); the crown and rings have no semantics.
- Name. Web: Back aria-label "Back"; Support and CTA from their text; the h1 reads "Unlock Equal Unlimited"; 🎊 is aria-hidden; the struck price is preceded by hidden ", was ". Android: Back "Back"; the title reads "Unlock Equal Unlimited" once; the 🎊 EmojiGlyphs are hidden; the was-price reads "was ₹249 /Monthly"; DiscountBadge reads "25% off. Special Coupon Applied!".
- Keyboard. Web: Tab: Back, Support, coupon APPLY, CTA; the locked preview is inert so its rows take no focus. Android: TalkBack: swipe through the bar, the title heading, price, preview, coupon and CTA.
- Touch target. Web: Back (40 px) and Support use eq-touch (48 px); the CTA is 45 px high, full width, with eq-touch. Android: Back 48 dp; Support uses minimumInteractiveComponentSize; the CTA EqualButton enforces 48 dp.
- Contrast. Web: Titles text/primary 11.5:1 and subtitle text/secondary 5.5:1 on the gold top. The gold caption label text/gold is 4.3:1 on the hero tint (4.6:1 on white). The price gradient is about 3:1 mid-glyph, lighter (#FFB251, 1.8:1) at its highlight. CTA white on gradient/cta-gold runs 4.2:1 at #A37236 to 2.3:1 at the #C8A774 sheen. "Saved ₹N" is text/action, 2.85:1 (accepted brand decision). Dark: gold text 9.3:1. Android: Same tokens, same ratios.
- State. Web: The footer CTA uses the native disabled attribute while a payment processes (grey fill, no sheen); the DiscountBadge is role="status". Android: EqualButton enabled = false; DiscountBadge is a polite live region.
- Motion. Web: Crown sway, gold CTA sheen and glow, the price drop and the badge pop all stop under prefers-reduced-motion, and PriceTag shows the final price at once. Android: Crown, sheen, glow, price drop and badge pop all hold still when rememberReduceMotion() is true.

Known accessibility gaps:
- Accepted brand decision (premium gold, subscription surfaces only): the white CTA label on gradient/cta-gold is 4.2:1 at the dark stop and about 2.3:1 at the #C8A774 sheen, below 4.5:1 for 14 px text (Button.css, Buttons.kt, tokens.json).
- Accepted brand decision (premium gold, subscription surfaces only): the gradient/gold-text price runs from #FFB251 (1.8:1 on white) to #603600, so the top of the 44 px digits falls under 3:1 even as large text (Monetization.css .eq-gold-text, Monetization.kt GoldText).
- Accepted brand decision: "Saved ₹N" and the DiscountBadge label use text/action #00B140 on white (2.85:1) in light (Monetization.tsx, Monetization.kt).

Example: Hero with price and preview
```tsx
<PaywallHero onBack={back} onSupport={openHelp}>
  <PriceTag price={249} />
  <LockedPreviewCard>…what's locked…</LockedPreviewCard>
</PaywallHero>
```
```kotlin
PaywallHero(onBack = {}, onSupport = { /* open HelpCenterSheet */ }) {
    PriceTag(price = "249")
    LockedPreviewCard {
        Column {
            ChatListItem(name = "HDFC RM", preview = "Loan pre-approval request", date = "1:00 PM",
                category = EqualCategory.GateAlert)
            EqualDivider()
            ChatListItem(name = "Vijay NoBroker", preview = "About miniature painting", date = "Yesterday",
                category = EqualCategory.RealEstate, locked = true)
        }
    }
}
```

Example: Preview by touchpoint
```tsx

<PaywallPreview touchpoint="chat" />
<PaywallPreview touchpoint="audio" />
```
```kotlin

    // Chat list
    LockedPreviewCard {
        ChatListItem(name = "Vijay NoBroker", preview = "About miniature painting", date = "Yesterday",
            category = EqualCategory.RealEstate, locked = true)
    }
    // Chat
    LockedPreviewCard {
        Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 12.dp)) {
            ChatBubble(type = ChatBubbleType.Outgoing, timestamp = "03:21", message = "Hello, who is this?")
            ChatBubble(type = ChatBubbleType.Incoming, incomingCategory = EqualCategory.RealEstate,
                timestamp = "03:21", message = "Vijay from no broker", modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 12.dp))
            ChatBubble(type = ChatBubbleType.Incoming, incomingCategory = EqualCategory.RealEstate,
                isFirstInGroup = false, timestamp = "03:21", locked = true, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 4.dp),
                message = "Hey this is vijay calling from magicbrick a property advisor")
        }
    }
    // Audio
    LockedPreviewCard {
        CallSummaryBubble(
            summary = "Hey Keshav! Here is the summary of your call.",
            timestamp = "03:21",
            locked = CallSummaryLock.Audio,
            onUnlock = { /* open paywall */ },
            voiceNote = {
                VoiceNotePlayer(isPlaying = false, onPlayPauseClick = {}, progress = 0f, elapsed = "0:00",
                    total = "2:37", speed = PlaybackSpeed.X1, onSpeedChange = {})
            },
            modifier = Modifier.padding(4.dp),
        )
    }
}
```

#### Paywall experiments (`monetization-experiments`)

The pieces the Android team A/B tests around the paywall: full-screen payment results, the processing strip, the sheet paywall with its coupon row, Help Center and exit offer, the offer strip, home notice and usage cards, Equal AI’s own notice, crown-locked actions and recordings.

- React: `import { PaymentResult, ProcessingStrip, PaywallSheet, CouponRow, HelpFaqSheet, ExitOfferDialog, OfferStrip, HomeNoticeCard, UsageCapCard, AssistantNoticeCard, SummaryActions, LockedRecording } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `PaymentResult`, `ProcessingStrip`, `PaywallSheet`, `CouponRow`, `HelpFaqSheet`, `ExitOfferDialog`, `OfferStrip`, `HomeNoticeCard`, `UsageCapCard`, `AssistantNoticeCard`, `SummaryActions`, `LockedRecording`
- Tokens: `gradient/status-success`, `gradient/status-warning`, `gradient/status-danger`, `sunburst/ray`, `expiry-banner/warning-bg`, `text/gold`, `plan-badge/expired-bg`, `plan-badge/expired-stroke`, `gradient/expired-badge`
- Source: All Payment States · Payment Pending · Home / Conversation Screen (light & dark) · Plan Expired & Usage Cap touchpoints · Recordings + Transcripts Locked · Actions on Home Page

Props of `PaymentResult`:
- `status`: `'success' | 'pending' | 'failed'`. Which page.
- `activeTill?`: `string` = '10th Sept 2026'. Success date.
- `pendingAction?`: `'refresh' | 'support'` = 'refresh'. Pending CTA.
- `header?`: `ReactNode`. Status bar on the wash.

Props of `PaywallSheet`:
- `price?`: `number` = 249. List price.
- `discountedPrice?`: `number` = 149. With EQUAL25.
- `applied?`: `boolean`. Coupon applied.
- `processing?`: `boolean`. Toast + disabled CTA.
- `cta?`: `string` = 'Unlock Equal AI Unlimited'. CTA copy (experiment).
- `mode?`: `'overlay' | 'inline'` = 'overlay'. Docs: inline.

Props of `ExitOfferDialog`:
- `dismissLabel?`: `string` = 'Not Now'. Leave in chats.
- `claimLabel?`: `string` = 'Claim 25% Off'. Keep 25% Off in chats.

Props of `ProcessingStrip`:
- `variant?`: `'strip' | 'card' | 'toast'` = 'strip'. Where it sits.

Do: Pass experiments as props on the same screen (Home, Chat, Paywall); never fork a screen per variant. While a payment is processing, show it everywhere it matters and disable the paywall CTA.

Don't: Don't show the exit offer more than once per session. Don't lock the caller's name, the time or the summary label; only content and actions.

Anatomy:
1. PaymentResult: Full-screen payment result with a tinted wash. (gradient/status-success|warning|danger · sunburst/ray rings · 52 bar · close or back chip bg/surface (36 web / 44 Compose, both 48 touch) · 84 art · title 30/36 Bold (h1) · sub 22/28 Regular · body body1 text/secondary, max 280 · success: 'PLAN ACTIVE TILL' caption text/secondary + date subheading Bold · block lg action pinned at the bottom)
2. ProcessingStrip: Payment processing notice with a spinning ring. (expiry-banner/warning-bg · padding 8/12 · gap 10 · 30 ring, 3dp text/gold arc on a 22% track around an 18 text/gold 'i' dot · title body2 Medium + caption Regular text/secondary · strip / card radius 12 / toast radius 12 with shadow)
3. PaywallSheet card: Compact gold paywall in a bottom sheet. (bg/surface panel radius 28 top · card radius 20 gradient/paywall-hero, 1dp paywall/card-stroke, padding 20/16/16 · Support top-right (48 touch) · crown 56 · 'Equal AI' 22/26 Regular over 'Unlimited' 34/38 Bold · micro text/gold discount line · price 34/40 gradient/gold-text)
4. CouponRow: EQUAL25 coupon with APPLY / APPLIED. (radius 14 · bg/surface · 1dp paywall/card-stroke · padding 10/14 · gap 10 · code subheading Bold text/gold · description caption Regular text/primary · APPLY body2 Bold text/gold (48 touch; 18% gold pill in dark))
5. ExitOfferDialog + OfferStrip: Exit offer card and the home strip after declining. (dialog radius 20, bg/surface, padding 18/16/16, shadow 0 12 40 black 22%, black 55% scrim, title Medium, body1 text/secondary, gold-outline + gold md buttons, gap 10 · strip expiry-banner/warning-bg + warning-text, info-fill 16, body2 Medium, underlined Bold Claim Now)
6. HomeNoticeCard / UsageCapCard: Home card with a CTA and optional usage bar. (radius 16 · bg/surface · 1dp stroke/subtle · padding 12/14 · title subheading (optional lead icon, gap 6) + caption Regular text/secondary · md primary Button · 6 bar, stroke/subtle track, button/primary fill, 10 above)
7. AssistantNoticeCard: Equal AI's own message with a voice note and CTA. (296 wide · radius 16 · bg/surface · VoicePlayer padding 8 · 'Equal AI' body2 text/action · title subheading · body body1 · 48 CTA row with crown-lock 18 + body2 Medium text/action)
8. SummaryActions + LockedRecording: Locked actions and recording on the free plan. (48 rows, 1dp stroke/subtle top · icon 18 + body2 Medium text/action · locked: crown-lock 16 + text/gold · recording blurred 2.5 on a paywall/hero-top → paywall/card-bg wash, radius 12 · 40 gradient/cta-gold badge with crown-lock 26)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: PaymentResult is a section with aria-label and an h1; ProcessingStrip and OfferStrip are role=status; PaywallSheet and HelpFaqSheet are role=dialog; ExitOfferDialog is role=alertdialog with aria-describedby; the usage bar is role=progressbar; LockedRecording is a button. Android: PaymentResult, PaywallSheet, HelpFaqSheet and ExitOfferDialog set paneTitle with heading() titles; ProcessingStrip merges with liveRegion Polite; price and the APPLY/APPLIED slot are live regions; LockedRecording is Role.Button with one description.
- Name. Web: Chips 'Close' / 'Back'; LockedRecording 'Recording locked. Unlock Equal AI Unlimited'; locked actions read 'Locked Call Back'; APPLY reads 'Apply EQUAL25'; the usage bar is labelled (e.g. 'Weekly calls used') with valuetext 'N% used'. Android: Same strings; the usage bar reads 'N% used'; the locked crown 'Locked'.
- Keyboard. Web: Sheets and dialogs use useModal: focus moves in, Tab is trapped, Escape closes (onClose, else onScrim / onBack / onDismiss). After APPLY, focus moves to APPLIED. Android: TalkBack: swipe and double-tap; scrims have onClickLabel 'Close'. System Back closes every sheet and the exit offer.
- Touch target. Web: Result chips (36), APPLY, Support and Claim Now use eq-touch (48); md and lg Buttons carry eq-touch (48). Android: EqualButton, APPLY, Support and Claim Now meet 48dp; the PaymentResult chip is 44dp inside a 48dp touchTarget().
- Contrast. Web: Accepted brand decision: primary buttons are white on green 2.85:1 and text/action CTAs and labels 2.85:1 in light. Offer strip 7.7:1 light / 9.0:1 dark; processing text 11.7:1; text/gold labels 4.6:1 on white but 4.0:1 on the paywall hero top; the gold CTA's white label runs 4.2:1 down to 2.3:1 across gradient/cta-gold; the gold-text price starts at 1.8:1. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: Processing is announced (role=status) and disables the CTA (disabled attribute). Locked actions show the crown and gold label plus 'Locked' in the name. APPLIED is announced through Announce ('Coupon EQUAL25 applied'). Android: Processing is a live region and the CTA is disabled; APPLIED and the new price are polite live regions.
- Motion. Web: Sheet slide-up, exit-offer spring, processing ring spin, price land, crown and gold CTA sheen; all stop under prefers-reduced-motion. Android: SheetLayer, the exit spring, the ring spin and the price land check rememberReduceMotion.

Known accessibility gaps:
- HomeNoticeCard usage bar in MonetizationExperiments.kt only sets contentDescription 'N% used', not progressBarRangeInfo, so TalkBack doesn't announce it as a progress bar (web uses role=progressbar).
- Accepted brand decision (premium gold, subscription surfaces only): gold CTAs (PaywallSheet Unlock, ExitOfferDialog Claim 25% Off; Button gold in Button.css and Buttons.kt) put white on gradient/cta-gold, 4.2:1 falling to 2.3:1; the label needs 4.5:1.
- Accepted brand decision: primary buttons and text/action labels (Refresh Status, Retry payment, AssistantNoticeCard CTA, unlocked SummaryActions, the usage bar fill) are 2.85:1 in light theme.


#### Plan banner (`plan-banner`)

The amber "Reactivate your current Plan…" strip for lapsed plans, under the plan card in Settings or at the top of a chat; plus the plan card link label (Manage plan / Restore Plan / Reactivate plan).

- React: `import { PlanBanner, PlanCard } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `PlanBanner`
- Tokens: `plan-banner/bg`, `plan-banner/text`
- Source: Monetization Flow · lapsed plan

Props of `PlanBanner`:
- `children`: `ReactNode`. Message.
- `attached?`: `boolean`. Hangs under the plan card.
- `onClick?`: `() => void`. Makes the strip tappable.

Do: Use it only when the plan has lapsed or autopay is off.

Don't: Don't use red; it is a nudge, not an error.

Anatomy:
1. Strip: Amber strip that nudges a lapsed plan. (plan-banner/bg · padding 8/12 · gap 8 · attached: inset 8, pulled 14 up under PlanCard, top padding 20, radius 14 bottom only)
2. Info icon: Marks the strip as a notice. (info-fill 16 · plan-banner/text · decorative)
3. Message: What to do, e.g. 'Reactivate your current Plan to use Equal Unlimited'. (caption · plan-banner/text)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: role=status when static; with onClick it is a div role=button with tabIndex 0 and an Enter/Space handler. Android: Plain text when static; with onClick an overlaid Box is clickable(Role.Button) and carries the text. No live region.
- Name. Web: The message text; the icon is aria-hidden. Android: The message text (set as the button's contentDescription); the icon has contentDescription null.
- Keyboard. Web: When tappable, Tab focuses it and Enter or Space activates it. Android: TalkBack: swipe to the strip, double-tap to reactivate.
- Touch target. Web: About 32 px tall (44 attached); with onClick, eq-touch gives a 48 px hit area. Android: About 32dp tall (44 attached); the button layer is at least 48dp tall, spilling evenly past the strip.
- Contrast. Web: plan-banner/text on plan-banner/bg is 4.65:1 light (just passes for the 12 px caption), 9.0:1 dark. Android: Same tokens: 4.65:1 light, 9.0:1 dark.
- State. Web: The lapsed plan is stated in the text; amber is supporting, never the only signal. Android: Same: the text carries the meaning.
- Motion. Web: No animation. Android: No animation.

Example: Under the plan card
```tsx
<PlanCard onManage={reactivate} actionLabel="Reactivate plan" />
<PlanBanner attached>Reactivate your current Plan to use Equal Unlimited</PlanBanner>
```
```kotlin
Column {
    PlanCard(onManageClick = { /* reactivate */ }, manageLabel = "Reactivate plan")
    PlanBanner(text = "Reactivate your current Plan to use Equal Unlimited", attached = true)
}
```

Example: At the top of a chat
```tsx
<PlanBanner onClick={reactivate}>Reactivate your current Plan to keep using Equal Unlimited</PlanBanner>
```
```kotlin
PlanBanner(text = "Reactivate your current Plan to keep using Equal Unlimited", onClick = { /* reactivate */ })
```

#### Plan expiry banner (`plan-expiry-banner`)

The strip under the home header as a plan runs out: amber while days remain, red on the last day and after it ends, always with Renew Now.

- React: `import { PlanExpiryBanner } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `PlanExpiryBanner`
- Tokens: `expiry-banner/warning-bg`, `expiry-banner/warning-icon-bg`, `expiry-banner/danger-icon-bg`, `expiry-banner/warning-text`, `expiry-banner/danger-bg`, `expiry-banner/danger-text`
- Source: Monetization value · Home Screen

Props of `PlanExpiryBanner`:
- `expiry`: `{ state: 'expiring', days } | { state: 'today' } | { state: 'expired', date }`. Where the plan stands; picks the tone and copy.
- `onRenew?`: `() => void`. Renew Now.

Do: Show it full width directly under the home header. Use amber while days remain, red from the last day.

Don't: Don't show it while the plan is comfortably active. Don't stack it with the Reactivate plan banner.

Anatomy:
1. Strip: Full-width strip under the home header as the plan runs out. (min 44 high · padding 6/12 · gap 10 · expiry-banner/warning-bg (days left) or expiry-banner/danger-bg (today, expired))
2. Icon disc: Info icon in a soft disc of the text colour. (info-fill 20 · 3dp padding · circle in expiry-banner/warning-icon-bg or danger-icon-bg · decorative)
3. Message: Where the plan stands, with the key part in Bold. (body2 · 'Your Plan Expires in 2 Days' / 'Expires Today' / 'Expired on 30th July' · expiry-banner/warning-text or danger-text)
4. Renew Now: Text action that opens renewal. (button token Bold · underlined, offset 3 · same text colour · 48 touch target)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: The strip is role=status with a native button inside. Android: The message has liveRegion Polite; Renew Now is clickable(Role.Button).
- Name. Web: Message text, e.g. 'Your Plan Expires in 2 Days'; button 'Renew Now'; icon aria-hidden. Android: Message text and 'Renew Now'; icon contentDescription null.
- Keyboard. Web: Tab to Renew Now, Enter/Space activates. Android: TalkBack reads the message, then 'Renew Now, Button'; double-tap renews.
- Touch target. Web: Renew Now uses eq-touch for a 48 px hit area around the text. Android: Renew Now uses minimumInteractiveComponentSize (48dp).
- Contrast. Web: Warning text 7.7:1 light / 9.0:1 dark; danger text 10.8:1 light / 7.7:1 dark. The link is marked by underline and Bold, not colour. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: Amber vs red always comes with the words 'Expires in N Days', 'Today' or 'Expired on'; the live region announces it when it changes. Android: Same; the polite live region announces the message.
- Motion. Web: No animation. Android: No animation.

Example: States
```tsx
<PlanExpiryBanner expiry={{ state: 'expiring', days: 2 }} onRenew={renew} />
<PlanExpiryBanner expiry={{ state: 'today' }} onRenew={renew} />
<PlanExpiryBanner expiry={{ state: 'expired', date: '30th July' }} onRenew={renew} />
```
```kotlin
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    PlanExpiryBanner(expiry = PlanExpiry.Expiring(days = 2), onRenew = { /* open PaywallScreen */ })
    PlanExpiryBanner(expiry = PlanExpiry.Today, onRenew = { /* open PaywallScreen */ })
    PlanExpiryBanner(expiry = PlanExpiry.Expired(date = "30th July"), onRenew = { /* open PaywallScreen */ })
}
```

#### Social proof (`social-proof`)

The subscription page proof block: a big gold stat, the rating pill and a testimonial carousel.

- React: `import { StatBlock, RatingPill, TestimonialCarousel } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `StatBlock`, `RatingPill`, `TestimonialCarousel`
- Tokens: `gradient/gold-text`, `text/gold`, `paywall/card-stroke`
- Source: Monetization Flow · Why people choose

Props of `StatBlock`:
- `value`: `string`. "400k+".
- `label`: `string`. Under it.

Props of `RatingPill`:
- `rating`: `number`. 4.5
- `outOf?`: `number` = 5. Scale.

Props of `TestimonialCarousel`:
- `items`: `{ quote; name; avatar? }[]`. Cards (240 wide), with page dots.

Do: Use real numbers and real reviews only.

Don't: Don't invent testimonials for production.

Anatomy:
1. Panel: SocialProof: gold-washed block with the section heading. (radius 28 bottom · bg/surface → paywall/card-bg (30%) wash · padding 24/16/20 · gap 16 · DividerLabel 'Why people choose' (heading) over 'EQUAL UNLIMITED' title Bold text/gold, gap 2)
2. StatBlock: Big gold stat with its label. (value 52/56 Bold -0.04em gradient/gold-text · label body2 text/primary)
3. RatingPill: Rating out of five. (36 high · padding 0 14 · radius 10 · bg/surface · 1dp paywall/card-stroke · shadow 0 2 6 black 6% · star-gold 20 · gap 6 · 'Rated' body2 · rating body2 Bold · '/5' body1 text/secondary)
4. TestimonialCarousel: card: One review card in a sideways scroller. (240 wide · gap 12 · radius 16 · bg/surface · 1dp stroke/subtle · padding 14, gap 14 · quote body1 text/secondary · avatar 36 + name body2, gap 10)
5. TestimonialCarousel: dots: Page dots under the cards. (6 · gap 6 · 10 above · stroke/medium, current text/gold · decorative)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: Cards are figure with blockquote and figcaption; the track is a plain scrolling div; dots are aria-hidden; 'Why people choose' is an h2. Android: Cards are Columns in a LazyRow; RatingPill is cleared to one description; dots are cleared; 'Why people choose' is a heading().
- Name. Web: Stat reads '400k+ People never miss a call'; rating reads 'Rated 4.5 /5' as separate spans; star alt is empty. Android: Rating reads 'Rated 4.5 out of 5'; the star has no description.
- Keyboard. Web: The track has no tabIndex and no buttons, so keyboard users can't scroll to later testimonials. Android: TalkBack swipes card by card and scrolls the LazyRow.
- Touch target. Web: Nothing is tappable; the 240 px cards scroll by swipe or trackpad. Android: Nothing is tappable; the 240dp cards scroll by swipe.
- Contrast. Web: The gold stat gradient runs 1.8:1 (#FFB251) to 10.4:1 on white at 52 px; 'EQUAL UNLIMITED' text/gold is 4.5:1 on paywall/card-bg (20 px Bold, large text); quotes and '/5' text/secondary 5.7:1. Dark uses the light gold tokens, 7:1 and up. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: Current page is shown only by the gold dot, which is hidden from assistive tech; no position is announced. Android: Dots are cleared; no page position is announced.
- Motion. Web: Scroll snapping only; no animation. Android: Snap fling only; no animation.

Known accessibility gaps:
- TestimonialCarousel track in Monetization.tsx is not focusable and has no controls, so keyboard users can't reach later testimonials; no platform announces the page position.
- Accepted brand decision (premium gold, subscription surfaces only): statBlock in Monetization.tsx paints text with background-clip and color: transparent (.eq-gold-text), so it disappears in forced-colors / high-contrast mode.
- Accepted brand decision (premium gold, subscription surfaces only): statBlock's gradient/gold-text (Monetization.css and GoldText in Monetization.kt) starts at #FFB251, 1.8:1 on white, so the light part of the 52 px stat is below 3:1.
- RatingPill in Monetization.tsx reads 'Rated 4.5 /5' from separate spans; Monetization.kt already says 'Rated 4.5 out of 5'.

Example: Stat and rating
```tsx
<StatBlock value="400k+" label="People never miss a call" />
<RatingPill rating={4.5} />
```
```kotlin
Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
    StatBlock(value = "400k+", label = "People never miss a call")
    RatingPill(rating = 4.5f)
}
```

Example: Testimonials
```tsx
<TestimonialCarousel items={[{ quote, name, avatar: <ProfileAvatar variant="female" size={36} /> }, …]} />
```
```kotlin
val avatar = @Composable { asset: EqualAssets -> EqualAssetImage(asset, size = 36.dp, modifier = Modifier.clip(CircleShape)) }
TestimonialCarousel(
    items = listOf(
        Testimonial(
            quote = "As a freelancer, client calls and spam used to mix together. Now I get proper summaries.",
            name = "keerthana",
            avatar = { avatar(EqualAssets.AvatarTestimonial1) },
        ),
        Testimonial(
            quote = "It is a very useful app for screening the unknown calls. This is a must download.",
            name = "Arnav Raj",
            avatar = { avatar(EqualAssets.AvatarTestimonial2) },
        ),
        Testimonial(
            quote = "My parents get loan and insurance calls all day. Equal answers them, and I just read the summary.",
            name = "Riya Kapoor",
            avatar = { avatar(EqualAssets.AvatarTestimonial3) },
        ),
    ),
)
```

#### Usage meter (`usage-meter`)

Known Call Usage Cap: the weekly allowance split by caller type. The Home card (three experiment options), the gold card on the weekly limit sheets, the green View Details sheet and the segmented meter they share. Every number is a prop.

- React: `import { UsageMeterCard, UsageLimitCard, UsageDetailsSheet, SegmentedMeter } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `UsageMeterCard`, `UsageLimitCard`, `UsageDetailsSheet`, `SegmentedMeter`, `MeterRow`, `MeterLegend`, `PriceDealCard`
- Tokens: `usage-meter/known`, `usage-meter/unknown`, `usage-meter/track`, `usage-meter/glow`, `usage-meter/gold-track`, `gradient/usage-meter-gold`, `gradient/usage-meter-gold-deep`, `expiry-chip/success-bg`, `info-note/title`
- Source: Known Call Usage Cap · Monetization 27 Aug Touchpoint

Do: Pass every number as a prop; the caps are product decisions. Show each gold limit sheet once per week per threshold. Keep the View Details sheet green: it is not a subscription surface.

Don't: Don't hard-code 80, 68 or 18. Don't use colour alone: the legend names each segment.

Anatomy:
1. Home card: Calls left, the meter, the reset and the upgrade path. (radius 16 · bg/surface · 1 value-card/stroke · usage-meter/glow wash · padding 12 · title body2 + call-filled 16 · xs Upgrade Now or 24 chevron chip (48 target))
2. Segmented meter: Known and unknown calls on one track. (6 (home) / 8 (sheets) high · radius full · usage-meter/track · segments value / total, 1 gap · known usage-meter/known, unknown usage-meter/unknown; gold sheets gradient/usage-meter-gold(-deep))
3. Legend: What each colour is. (swatch 8 radius 2 · caption text/secondary · gap 8 · reset caption Regular on the right)
4. Limit card: The gold card on the weekly limit sheets. (ValueCard frame + premium glow · head 30/36 Bold or headline · gold box radius 12 · Resets in chip · perks · plan row)
5. View Details: The green explainer sheet. (radius 28 top · orbit 166 · title 700 · meter card radius 16 · green chip · perks or info note · lg block CTA)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: The meter is one role='progressbar' with aria-valuetext ("49 known, 15 unknown of 80 calls used"); the details sheet is a dialog; the info note is role='note'. Android: Meter semantics: contentDescription + stateDescription + progressBarRangeInfo; the sheet sets paneTitle.
- Name. Web: The card title is a heading; the chevron chip is "View details". Android: Title is a heading; the chip has onClickLabel "View details".
- Keyboard. Web: Tab reaches Upgrade Now / the chip / View Details; Escape closes the sheets. Android: D-pad through the same; Back closes the sheets.
- Touch target. Web: The 24 chip sits in a 44 target (eq-touch); xs buttons keep a 44 target. Android: minimumInteractiveComponentSize gives 48dp.
- Contrast. Web: Legend text/secondary on white passes; segments are non-text (≥ 3:1 vs the track in dark via usage-meter/unknown #7A9E2E); the green chip text is 6.6:1. Android: Same tokens.
- State. Web: Every segment is named in the legend and in the value text, so colour is not the only cue. Android: Same.
- Motion. Web: The orbit rings and sparkles stop under reduced motion; sheets don't slide. Android: UsageOrbit holds still under rememberReduceMotion().

Known accessibility gaps:
- Light-mode known segment (#00B140) vs the #F0F0F0 track is 2.5:1, below 3:1; the legend and value text carry the meaning.

Example: Home card options
```tsx
<UsageMeterCard used={{ known: 49, unknown: 15 }} total={80} cta="details" onUpgrade={upgrade} onDetails={details} />
<UsageMeterCard used={{ known: 49, unknown: 15 }} total={80} cta="chevron" />
<UsageMeterCard used={{ known: 18, unknown: 40 }} total={80} state="unknown-cap" resetsIn="2 days" cta="chevron-gold" />
```
```kotlin
UsageMeterCard(UsageMeterSpec(CallSplit(49, 15), total = 80, cta = UsageCardCta.Details), onUpgrade = { /* paywall */ }, onDetails = { /* details */ })
UsageMeterCard(UsageMeterSpec(CallSplit(49, 15), total = 80, cta = UsageCardCta.Chevron))
UsageMeterCard(UsageMeterSpec(CallSplit(18, 40), total = 80, state = UsageState.UnknownCap, resetsIn = "2 days", cta = UsageCardCta.ChevronGold))
```

Example: Limit card
```tsx
<ValueSheet card={<UsageLimitCard used={{ known: 62, unknown: 18 }} limits={{ known: 68, unknown: 18 }} total={80} meter="rows" resetsInDays={2} />} onRenew={upgrade} onClose={close} />
```
```kotlin
ValueSheet(
    card = { UsageLimitCard(CallSplit(62, 18), CallSplit(68, 18), total = 80, resetsInDays = 2, rows = true) },
    onRenew = { /* paywall */ },
    onClose = { /* close */ },
)
```

Example: View Details
```tsx
<UsageDetailsSheet used={{ known: 9, unknown: 4 }} limits={{ known: 68, unknown: 12 }} total={80} resetsInDays={2} body="info" onUpgrade={upgrade} onClose={close} />
```
```kotlin
UsageDetailsSheet(
    used = CallSplit(9, 4),
    limits = CallSplit(68, 12),
    total = 80,
    resetsInDays = 2,
    info = true,
    onUpgrade = { /* paywall */ },
    onClose = { /* close */ },
)
```

Example: iOS-parity price card
```tsx
<PriceDealCard price={499} />
```
```kotlin

```

#### Value card & sheet (`value-card`)

What Unlimited saved you: calls handled, the perks, the expiry chip and the current plan. Inside the sheet that rises after a call near the end of a plan, and on the plan page (circuit pattern, no perks). For free users the QuotaCard counts the week’s calls instead.

- React: `import { ValueCard, QuotaCard, ValueSheet, ExpiryChip, PremiumIcon } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `ValueCard`, `QuotaCard`, `ValueSheet`, `ExpiryChip`, `PremiumIcon`
- Tokens: `premium-icon/start`, `premium-icon/end`, `gradient/value-card`, `value-card/stroke`, `value-card/perks-bg`, `value-card/ring`, `expiry-chip/warning-bg`, `expiry-chip/danger-bg`, `expiry-chip/active-bg`
- Source: Monetization value · Value Bottom Sheet Once Called

Props of `ValueCard`:
- `calls`: `number`. Calls the assistant handled.
- `expiry`: `PlanExpiry`. active (until) · expiring (days) · today · expired (date).
- `title?`: `string | null` = 'What Unlimited saved you'. In-card heading; null on the plan page.
- `perks?`: `ValuePerk[] | null` = defaultValuePerks. The three rows; null hides them.
- `price?`: `number` = 39. Current price.
- `was?`: `number` = 49. Struck list price.
- `pattern?`: `'rings' | 'circuit'` = circuit when perks is null. Rings (sheet) or the gold circuit lines (plan page).

Props of `PremiumIcon`:
- `name`: `IconName`. A filled Material Symbol (the -fill icons, timer, person, call-log).
- `size?`: `number` = 16. dp.

Props of `QuotaCard`:
- `quota`: `{ used: number; limit: number; resetsInDays: number }`. This week; used ≥ limit shows Limit Reached.
- `perks?`: `ValuePerk[] | null` = quotaPerks. What Unlimited adds.
- `price?`: `number` = 149. Price.
- `was?`: `number` = 249. Struck list price.

Props of `ValueSheet`:
- `expiry?`: `PlanExpiry`. Paid plan state.
- `quota?`: `Quota`. Free plan: show the QuotaCard (CTA Get Equal AI Unlimited).
- `calls?`: `number` = 20. Calls handled.
- `variant?`: `'card' | 'flush'` = 'card'. Inset card or the card as the sheet (experiment).
- `cta?`: `string` = 'Renew your Equal AI'. Gold CTA.
- `onRenew?`: `() => void`. CTA.
- `onClose?`: `() => void`. The floating close and the scrim.

Do: Show the sheet once, after the assistant handles a call in the last days of a plan. Lead with the number; the user should see what they get before the ask. Perk icons are filled Material Symbols at 16 dp in the premium gold gradient (PremiumIcon), never outlined or flat-tinted. Light cards sit on the premium-glow art; dark cards use the coded black-gold gradient.

Don't: Don't show the sheet on every call or app open. Don't use it for users who never subscribed; they get the paywall.

Anatomy:
1. Container: ValueCard: the gold card that shows what Unlimited did before asking for renewal. (radius 20 · 1dp value-card/stroke · padding 18/0/14 · gap 14 · light rings: bg/surface + premium-glow art · dark: gradient/value-card + value-card/ring rings · circuit: paywall/card-bg → bg/surface + gold circuit (45% in dark))
2. Title: In-card heading, hidden on the plan page. (DividerLabel · subheading Medium uppercase · paywall/divider hairlines · inset 16)
3. Stat: Calls the assistant handled. (count 48/52 Bold -0.04em tabular text/primary · 'Calls Handled' title Medium over 'by your Assistant' body1 · gap 12 · padding 4/16)
4. PerkList: Three things Unlimited did, each with a gold icon. (inset 16 · radius 14 · value-card/perks-bg · 1dp value-card/stroke · rows padding 10/12, gap 10 · PremiumIcon 16 (premium-icon/start → end) + body2 Regular text/primary)
5. Date row + ExpiryChip: When the plan ends, with a tinted chip. (paywall/divider rules (min 12) · label body1 · gap 8 · chip 30 high, radius 6, padding 0 8, 18 Bold tabular · active text/gold on expiry-chip/active-bg · warning / danger expiry-chip tokens)
6. PlanPriceRow: Current plan and its price. (inset 16 · 'Current Plan' caption Regular text/secondary over plan title SemiBold · ₹price subheading Bold · struck ₹was and period caption text/secondary)
7. ValueSheet: close and CTA: The sheet around the card: floating close and the gold renew button. (panel bg/primary radius 24 top · 44 neutral close 16 above, centred (48 touch) · block gold CTA, padding 16: 'Renew your Equal AI' on gradient/cta-renew, 'Get Equal AI Unlimited' on gradient/cta-gold · flush: card is the top, CTA on bg/surface under 1dp stroke/subtle)
8. QuotaCard: head and bar: Free plan: calls left this week and a gold bar. ('6 out of 30' 30/36 Bold + 'Calls Left' 18 Medium · 10 bar, paywall/divider track, gradient/cta-gold fill · body1 text/secondary line, bold part text/primary · 'Limit Reached' replaces both at the limit)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: ValueCard and QuotaCard are <section aria-label>; PerkList is a ul; the quota bar is role=progressbar with min, max and now; ValueSheet is role=dialog (aria-modal in overlay). Android: The stat row uses clearAndSetSemantics; the quota bar sets progressBarRangeInfo; the sheet panel sets paneTitle.
- Name. Web: Section label is the title or 'N out of M calls left' / 'Limit reached'; bar 'Calls handled this week'; close 'Close'; CTA by its text. PremiumIcon is aria-hidden. Android: Stat reads '20 Calls Handled by your Assistant'; bar 'Calls handled this week'; close 'Close'; scrim onClickLabel 'Close'. PremiumIcon has no description.
- Keyboard. Web: useModal moves focus in, traps Tab and closes on Escape; the scrim click also closes. Tab reaches Close then the CTA. Android: TalkBack: swipe through the card, then the CTA; Close sits above the panel. System Back calls onClose.
- Touch target. Web: Close is 44 px with eq-touch (48); the gold lg CTA is 45 px with eq-touch (48). Android: Close is a 44dp circle in a 48dp box; EqualButton enforces 48dp.
- Contrast. Web: Text is text/primary (12.6:1) or text/secondary (5.7:1). ExpiryChip: active text/gold on expiry-chip/active-bg is 4.1:1 light (fails for 18 px Bold) / 7.3:1 dark; warning 7.2 / 10.2; danger 9.5 / 7.2. Renew CTA white runs 2.2:1 to 4.9:1 across gradient/cta-renew; the gold CTA's white label runs 4.2:1 down to 2.3:1 across gradient/cta-gold. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: Expiry tone always comes with words ('Plan Expires in', 'Today', 'Expired on'). The quota bar exposes its value; at the limit it is replaced by 'Limit Reached'. The struck ₹was is preceded by a visually hidden 'was'. Android: Same wording carries the tone. The price row's contentDescription reads '₹39, was ₹49 /Monthly'.
- Motion. Web: Sheet slides up (motion.slow); gold CTA sheen and glow; all stop under prefers-reduced-motion. Android: The ValueSheet slide-up and fade and the gold CTA sheen/glow are static under rememberReduceMotion().

Known accessibility gaps:
- Accepted brand decision (premium gold, subscription surfaces only): valueSheet gold CTAs (Button gold, Button.css / Monetization.css and Buttons.kt): white on gradient/cta-renew falls to 2.2:1 at #D1A85C, and white on gradient/cta-gold to 2.3:1 at #C8A774; the label needs 4.5:1.

Example: Sheet
```tsx
<ValueSheet expiry={{ state: 'expiring', days: 3 }} onRenew={renew} onClose={close} />
```
```kotlin
// Overlay: fills the screen (scrim + sheet); pass inline = true to draw only the panel
ValueSheet(
    expiry = PlanExpiry.Expiring(days = 3),
    onRenew = { /* open PaywallScreen(cta = "Get Equal AI Unlimited") */ },
    onClose = { /* hide the sheet */ },
)
```
